effect.name: Alpha Mask
effect.description: Cuts the object out using a second image you supply. Anything you can draw, you can mask with: torn paper edges, a spotlight, a window in a wall, a hand-drawn transition.
effect.author: CyberMushroom

parameter.name: Offset X
parameter.description: Slides the mask sideways, where 1 is its full width.

parameter.name: Channel
parameter.description: Which part of the mask to read: 0 alpha, 1 luminance, 2 red, 3 green, 4 blue.

parameter.name: Contrast
parameter.description: Hardens the mask around its midpoint. High values turn a soft gradient into a crisp cut.

parameter.name: Invert
parameter.description: On keeps what the mask hides and hides what it keeps.

parameter.name: Tile
parameter.description: On repeats the mask instead of stretching one copy across the object.

parameter.name: Mask Image
parameter.description: The image to mask with. White or opaque keeps the pixel, black or transparent removes it.
